about: Bundles (plans/22-bundles.md, D-39): sets of questions players switch on or off before a session. Every question is in exactly one bundle (`bundle`, default base). Bundles add questions and don't own a topic. `rule` (English) is how the pipeline decides membership; `name` and `description` are for the game.

bundles.name: Básico
bundles.description: Preguntas de todo un poco, para jugar en cualquier parte.
bundles.rule: Everything that isn't in another bundle: answerable by players of the focus group anywhere in the Spanish-speaking world, including well-known facts about Colombia (its capital, its flag, coffee, García Márquez).

bundles.name: Colombia
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con Colombia: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Colombia: Colombian places, food, customs, festivals, people, music, sport, words, sayings or history that players of the focus group outside Colombia mostly wouldn't know.
